title: The final analysis does not construct a P1/P3 conversion
statement: P3 identity spaces and complete feasible-witness sets do not supply the probability law or positive local mixture weights required by P1 adaptive source restoration. The generic circuit-support operation also lacks a general feasible-witness decoder. This package constructs no such conversion and claims no synthesis from shared terminology. It is an identified unpaid interface here, not a universal impossibility theorem or a new researcher assignment.
